meta.note: Basecalled with MIXED dorado versions (034/081/090, sup, 5mCG_5hmCG). Homopolymer accuracy differs across those releases and this is a homopolymer error model (applies to BOTH the dupC 8C null and the delCC 5C null), so f is a MIXTURE over basecalling regimes — conservative (includes older, noisier basecallers) rather than matched to any single one. Rebuild on your own controls if your chemistry or basecaller differs.
